summary: Frontend-only verification of per-conversation draft persistence in the reply composer for /alex. Covered: typing draft in Mara Direct Talk, switching to other conversations (Devon Direct Talk / Design-team Group / Field-notes Channel discovered), verifying other composer is empty, restoring Mara draft on return, persistence across full page reload, clear-on-send behavior, no stale draft after switch-back, and Write/Preview + Enter-to-send regressions with a restored draft. All 13/13 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: drop-composer.tsx correctly initializes body from talkService.getDraft(draftKey) and reloads on draftKey change via useEffect, also resetting preview mode.
onChange saves via talkService.saveDraft; submit clears the persisted draft before setBody('') — order is safe.

mock-talk-service getDraft/saveDraft use a single localStorage key 'kodama-talk/v1/drafts' as a map keyed by conversation id — clean and namespaced; sendMessage also clears the draft server-side which is redundant but defensive (verified: after send, LS becomes {}).

Minor: draftKey is optional; when omitted the composer degrades gracefully (Door composer path). Consider trimming empty-string entries from the drafts map on save to keep localStorage clean (non-blocking).
test_credentials: Owner unlock for /alex: any 4+ char password (used 'secret'). Device was already remembered from prior sessions.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded conv-mara (Talk), conv-devon (Talk), conv-design-team (Group), conv-field-notes (Channel).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-conversation draft persistence confirmed. LS key: 'kodama-talk/v1/drafts' -> {conversationId: body}. Draft survives conversation switching (any tab) and full page reload; cleared on send; empty for conversations without a draft. Preview/Write toggle and Enter-to-send unaffected by restored drafts. Selectors used: [data-testid='conversation-row-conv-mara' | 'conv-devon' | 'conv-design-team' | 'conv-field-notes'], [data-testid='drop-composer-field'], [data-testid='drop-composer-send'], [data-testid='drop-composer-write-tab'|'drop-composer-preview-tab'|'drop-composer-preview']. Note: clearing all 'kodama-talk/v1/*' keys will re-lock owner; clear only 'kodama-talk/v1/drafts' between tests.
